messages:
lena: quick sync 0min - NimbusCloud asked for a tiny terraform onramp we can hand to their SWEs. goal: 5-min run, two example flavors (on-prem-ish baremetal + cloud vm), and a single smoke harness that hits the hosted API and our private deploy mock.

arjun: sounds good. recommend keeping modules <200 LOC and avoid any provider hacks. we should provide both a module and a thin example overlay so partners can copy/paste.

katie: agree. please include a note about image registry placement for quantized artifacts and a small example of a kms var. partners keep tripping over where to store model bits.

lena: draft plan: repo path /terraform/nimbus/onramp -> modules/{core, gpu_pool}, examples/{vm,x86-arm,baremetal}. README with checklist + sizing table. will add PARTNER_QUICKSTART.md too.

ben: small nit: for the baremetal overlay, make sure we add a fallback to CPU-only so they can run on dev benches. put a comment about performance tradeoffs.

arjun: include a minimal smoke.sh in examples that does: export REDWOOD_API_KEY=...; curl -sS -X POST $API/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' | jq .output; check exit code and latency. keep the model a tiny local stub.

lena: pasted example snippet for main.tf in README:

```hcl
module "redwood_onramp" {
  source       = "github.com/redwood/refkit/terraform/nimbus/onramp/modules/core"
  region       = var.region
  instance_cls = var.use_arm ? "t4g.small" : "g4dn.xlarge"
  gpu_enabled  = var.gpu_enabled
  kms_key_id   = var.customer_kms_key_id # do NOT hardcode, pass from partner env
}

variable "use_arm" { type = bool, default = false }
```

katie: good. also add a tiny mapping table: t4g.small -> ~10 qps (tiny stub), g4dn.xlarge -> ~35 qps. label as "approx" and link to perf profiles.

infra-bot: Repository stub created: github.com/redwood/refkit/tree/nimbus/onramp (branch: nimbus-onramp-skeleton).

ben: for CI, make the workflow opt-in. add a label `integration/optional` and guard workflow with `if: github.event.pull_request.labels contains 'integration/optional'` so it doesn't block merges.

arjun: oof that label check is slightly awkward in GH actions but doable. devops can add a matrix for `use_arm: [true,false]` so we validate both overlays in one run.

lena: action items: (1) lena: push skeleton + PARTNER_QUICKSTART.md (2) arjun: draft CI with opt-in label + matrix (3) katie: write README security section + kms/hsm notes (4) ben: add smoke.sh and terraform validate job. i'll tag Nimbus PM in partner slack after PR.

katie: for the README security blurb: include a short section about audit logging, KMS rotation, and not storing plaintext model keys in state files. tiny code snippet showing `backend "s3" { encrypt = true }` example.

ben: good call. also add a short troubleshooting FAQ: "terraform apply hangs" -> often due to missing provider creds; point to partner quickstart.

infra-bot: Pull request opened: https://github.com/redwood/refkit/pull/58 - "nimbus/onramp: lightweight terraform onramp + quickstart" reviewers: katie, arjun, ben.

lena: PR up. assigning reviewers. will include screenshots for README.

arjun: will review CI tomorrow. quick ask: can we include an ARM perf note that some sparse kernels are slower on older t4g hardware? i'll add a parenthetical.

katie: yes add that. also add contact line: partners@redwood.com for provisioning demo tokens and short-lived dedicated nodes.

lena: thanks all. keeping it tiny should speed partner enablement. will post final merge after fixes.
